parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 activity rows for human single-protein target CHEMBL3975 (Fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase 1). Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pchembl_value. Join molecule_dictionary, activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
